post.description: Start a conversation with its first message.
Add a turn. Returns 409 while the thread's previous run is still going.

get.description: What the model saw: the run's history in its current epoch.

Server-sent events for one run: stored events after ``after`` (or the
``Last-Event-ID`` header), then live events until the run stops.
The full text of a tool result that was truncated for the model.

post.description: Create a job from the UI. It is active at once: the user is the one asking.
The kill switch: pause every active job.
Activate a job the agent proposed.
Fire an active job at the next scheduler tick instead of waiting.
Approve or decline. When nothing else is pending for the run, it resumes.

get.description: Eval runs written by ``kairos-evals run --out postgres:...``, newest first.

put.description:
``actions_enabled=false`` denies every agent action with a side effect and
pauses all active jobs.

post.description: Queue a test message on the chosen channels (console and push by default).

Approval.title: Approval
Approval.description: A tool call waiting for (or decided by) a human.

ApprovalRequested.title: ApprovalRequested
ApprovalRequested.description: A tool call waits for a human. The run pauses until every such call is decided.

AuditEntry.title: AuditEntry
AuditEntry.description: One thing that happened with a side effect, or a human decision.

BudgetSpent.title: BudgetSpent
BudgetSpent.description: What a run has consumed so far, in the same dimensions as :class:`Budget`.

Changed.title: Changed
Changed.description: The value moved by at least ``min_delta`` since the previous observation.

ContextCompacted.title: ContextCompacted
ContextCompacted.description:
The context grew too large and was replaced by a summary (a new epoch).

The previous epoch's messages are kept in full as ``archive_blob_id``.

CronSchedule.title: CronSchedule
CronSchedule.description: Standard five-field cron, evaluated in local wall-clock time of ``timezone``.

IntervalSchedule.title: IntervalSchedule
IntervalSchedule.description: Every N seconds of elapsed time (daylight saving does not affect it).

JobPatch.title: JobPatch
JobPatch.description: Change a job's definition, its status, or both.

JobRun.title: JobRun
JobRun.description: One firing of a job and the agent run it started.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: For tasks: what the agent should do.

JobSpec.title: JobSpec
JobSpec.description: The editable part of a job.

JobSummary.title: JobSummary
JobSummary.description: A row of the Tasks page.

ModelCallFinished.title: ModelCallFinished
ModelCallFinished.description: One model call completed. ``model`` is the model that actually answered.

ModelStreamReset.title: ModelStreamReset
ModelStreamReset.description: The model stream failed and is being retried. Discard deltas shown for this step.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: What a watch run saw. ``value`` is set when the extract is a number.

OpaqueBlock.title: OpaqueBlock
OpaqueBlock.description:
A provider-native block the harness does not interpret but must replay verbatim.

Thinking blocks are the main case: current Claude models reject a history in
which they were altered or dropped selectively. ``data`` is the provider's own
JSON for the block; ``provider`` says which provider can read it back.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description:
Where content came from, which decides whether it may be treated as instructions.

``UNTRUSTED`` content (web pages, email, documents, third-party APIs) is data.
The harness wraps it in delimited blocks before the model sees it.

RunDetail.title: RunDetail
RunDetail.description: A run with its durable event log: enough to render the turn or its trace.

RunFinished.title: RunFinished
RunFinished.description: The loop stopped. For pauses the run can continue later; otherwise it is final.

RunResumed.title: RunResumed
RunResumed.description: A process picked up an existing run from its checkpoint.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description: One turn: the user's input and how the run that answered it ended.

StepFinished.title: StepFinished
StepFinished.description: The step's model call and its whole tool batch are done and checkpointed.

StopReason.title: StopReason
StopReason.description: Why the loop stopped. Every exit from the loop names exactly one.

ToolCallEnd.title: ToolCallEnd
ToolCallEnd.description: The model finished writing the call. ``input`` is the complete, parsed input.

ToolCallUncertain.title: ToolCallUncertain
ToolCallUncertain.description: A non-idempotent call was interrupted; its outcome is unknown. The run pauses.

ToolResultBlock.title: ToolResultBlock
ToolResultBlock.description:
The outcome of a tool call, exactly as the model saw it.

``content`` is already truncated and, for untrusted tools, already wrapped.

ToolRisk.title: ToolRisk
ToolRisk.description: How much damage a tool call can do. The policy engine keys approval rules on this.

ToolUseBlock.title: ToolUseBlock
ToolUseBlock.description: The model asking for a tool to be called.

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description:
Token counts for one model call, or a running total.

``input_tokens`` counts only uncached input, as the Anthropic API reports it.

target.title: Target
target.description: A URL, or a search query, describing where to look.

extract.title: Extract
extract.description: What to read from the target, e.g. 'lowest round-trip fare in CAD'.

WatchSpec.title: WatchSpec
WatchSpec.description: What to look at, what to extract, and when to raise an alert.
